Priya Kapoor: quick follow-up from the postmortem — listing cross-team action items we agreed on. please confirm you're OK to own and the due date (or reassign). I'll compile and ping later.

Alex Chen: I can take the cache invalidation script cleanup (item A). target: 2026-05-05 EOD. tagging infra for rollout verification. :white_check_mark:

Jorge Martinez: I will own the SLA doc update + include the new fallback behaviour (item B). deadline 2026-05-07. will add PR today.

Sam Reed: I'll pick up the monitoring dashboard alert tuning (item C) but need until 2026-05-08 — current alert noise needs a short eval window.

Taylor Ng: For the DB failover checklist (item D) — I need one co-owner from infra. @Alex Chen can you be backup? If yes I'll set deadline 2026-05-06.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-137 follow-up reminder — 72h check-in scheduled.

Alex Chen: @Taylor Ng yep I can be backup for item D. also will run the verification command after the rollout: ```curl -sS https://metrics.internal/redwood/cache-health | jq .miss_rate``` aim to be <0.8% post-fix.

Priya Kapoor: thanks — can everyone reply with either "ACK" or "REASSIGN -> @name" and confirm the date in YYYY-MM-DD so I can lock them into the tracker? will run a short check-in next Wed.

Jorge Martinez: ACK 2026-05-07

Sam Reed: ACK 2026-05-08 (might push to 2026-05-09 if noise remains)

Taylor Ng: ACK 2026-05-06 (Alex backup)

Alex Chen: ACK 2026-05-05

Priya Kapoor: perfect — I added these to the postmortem actions spreadsheet and set a follow-up reminder: 2026-05-10 to verify closure across teams. if anything changes, reply here or update the sheet: https://docs.internal/rw-postmortems/2026-137

Sam Reed: noted, I'll attach a short runbook snippet to the dashboard PR so SRE can onboard quicker.

Priya Kapoor: one more small ask — when you close the item, paste the verification step (command/output) in this thread so I can mark it verified. thanks everyone :pray:
